about_the_game:
Can you survive the first 90-days probation on the job? For those who love pulling pranks or thrive in the chaos of office life! Uncover the mystery behind this company’s high turnover rate. Why are people leaving, and why are they so desperate to hire you?

Choose Your Path:

  • Work Hard:  Stay productive, tackle daily tasks, and meet the company’s demands.

  • Slack Off: Balance work and leisure. Overtime for extra cash can be boring, so why not pull a prank or get others to do your work?

Gameplay Highlights:

  • Office Lifestyle: Engage in hilarious pranks. If you get caught, your social credit decreases, but if you succeed, you earn double the points!

  • Explore Downtown: Cruise around Downtown to discover other ways to earn cash.

  • Customization Options: Use various options to customize your hair, accessories, colors, and more!
